Very disappointed
Oct 2023 • Family
I had eaten here before. Was shocked at the decline in quality, taste and selection. We ordered the chicken enchilada and the chicken pieces of some sort. Both were served quite cold. So cold it was not enjoyable to eat. Neither came with anything such as beans, rice or salad. And the menu did not say they did. Which is fair. But the portion size was so small we left hungry. The enchilada sauce was bland at best and nothing I have ever experience before in Mexican cuisine anywhere. And this place is owned by a Mexican. The chicken was made with a BBQ sauce like you would get out of most bottled BBQ sauce. Nothing like you would expect at a Mexican restaurant. Disappointing, because at one time it was pretty good food. But I will not be back.

AMAZING Mexican Food!!! Must Eat.
Nov 2022 • Couples
If you’re craving authentic Mexican food, Los Chilangos is a must! Mario and his family are so friendly and welcoming- we enjoyed chatting and learning about their journey around the world. Make sure you ask Mario about his work as a Marine Biologist! The atmosphere makes it feel like you’re truly in Mexico City- well worth the 20 minute walk from the beach. 

My wife ordered the Thursday special of 5 pork tacos and I ordered the chorizo burrito. The tortillas were homemade and tasted so fresh, not to mention the mouth watering pork. YUM! We also shared chips and pico and horchata. The salsa is so delicious but pretty spicy. I wish they sold bottles of them! 

Literally EVERYTHING is homemade. Doesn’t get any better than this. 

Oh, if you’re there on a Saturday night youll get to partake in their dancing Fiesta. So sad we missed out on that opportunity :( 

Do yourself a favor and give them a try :)

 
From Your fellow traveling Nursing duo,
Kate and Kamal

Amazing 100% authentic mexican food and incredible ambience! You cannot miss it!
Oct 2022 • Friends
We went last Saturday to have dinner, the food was amazing, 100% authentic Mexican food. Everything is homemade, even the tortillas! Mario and his family were lovely, really attentive all the night with us. Moreover, every Saturday they organize a salsa night so many people gather there to dance salsa, bachata, merengue and many more. I did not have any clue of how to dance salsa but Mario was super attentive and dedicate me some time to tech me the basic steps so I could enjoy the dinner while dancing. We felt really welcome at this restaurant and for sure we will come back soon and enjoy many more salsa nights!
